```{r}
library(data.table)
```

```{r}
all_files <- list.files("Raw", pattern="*.gz", full.names = T)
names(all_files) <- gsub(".txt.gz","",basename(all_files))

all_tabs <- list()
for (n in names(all_files)) {
  tmp <- fread(all_files[[n]], sep="\t")
  setkey(tmp, "Gene ID")
  all_tabs[[n]] <- tmp
}


gene_anno = all_tabs[[1]][,c("Gene Symbol","Gene ID")]
# fix date like gene symbols
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
gs <- select(org.Hs.eg.db, keys=gene_anno$`Gene ID`, keytype = "ENTREZID", columns="SYMBOL")
gene_anno <- merge(gene_anno, gs, by.x="Gene ID", by.y="ENTREZID", all.x=T, sort=F)
gene_anno[["Gene Symbol"]] <- NULL
setnames(gene_anno, "SYMBOL", "GeneSymbol")

final_tab <- gene_anno

for (n in names(all_tabs)) {
  tmp <- all_tabs[[n]]
  sn <- colnames(tmp)[3]
  final_tab[[n]] <- tmp[final_tab$`Gene ID`,][[sn]]
}


```

```{r}
boxplot(as.matrix(final_tab[, 3:ncol(final_tab)]))
```

```{r}
saveRDS(final_tab, "GSE173264_iPSC_CDX2_mat.rds", compress=T)
```
